scope_note: STATADIC-LINEAR-006 treats a finite law and whitened-coordinate competitors. STATADIC-LINEAR-011 covers arbitrary square-integrable laws and original-coordinate competitors. Both specialize the published covariance model to known positive diagonal precisions and an invertible weighted Gram matrix.
